messages:
Ram Patel: Evening handoff — quick notes from my shift.

Ram Patel: Summary: no incidents. Platform latency wiggle around 95th pct for embeddings during the 18:30-18:40 window; I restarted the embedding pool on ded-1 which trimmed p95 by ~60ms. No customer-facing errors.

Maya Chen: Thanks Ram. Any idea what triggered the spike?

Ram Patel: Looks correlated with a deploy to the search microservice at 18:27 (deploy-bot trace: deploy_2026_11_09). The new indexing job created a burst of long-running requests. I raised a PR to add a rate limiter, see #PR-6347.

Liam O'Keefe: Pinged on PR-6347 for code review. Short-term: is moving the index job to off-peak an option? :clock1: 

Ram Patel: I scheduled the heavy index run for 03:00 in the staging->prod pipeline for tomorrow. For now added a temporary concurrency cap in the config: `indexer.max_parallel=4`.

Sophia Rivera: Noted. Two small asks for the next shift:
1) Watch the KV cache hit rate for chat-models on ded-2 — it dipped from 92% to ~78% during the spike.
2) If p95 for embeddings stays >700ms for 10m, escalate to infra and open a reduced-load canary.

Maya Chen: I'll own the KV cache watch. Where do you want the alerts? Pager or slack?

Sophia Rivera: Slack first; pager if it stays bad for >15m. Add an alert rule to the oncall dashboard under 'Cache' -> 'kv_hit_rate'.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Night shift coverage swap is tomorrow. Auto-assigning Liam O'Keefe. React with :thumbsup: to accept or DM @ops to swap.

Liam O'Keefe: Accepting. :thumbsup: 

Ram Patel: Action items for next shift:
- Maya: add the 'kv_hit_rate' alert and confirm thresholds (85% ok)
- Liam: follow up on PR-6347 review and coordinate with infra if embedding p95 persists
- Sophia: verify the 03:00 reschedule takes effect and confirm indexer concurrency change in prod

Maya Chen: Will do, leaving notes in the runbook under 'embedding-ops' and 'cache-playbook'.

Ram Patel: Thanks team — nothing else blocking from my side. Handing off. /end
